description: ORVEXIA is a team of five enthusiastic young women united by our curiosity, creativity, and passion for space exploration and technology.Through the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we aim to turn our ideas into innovative solutions, collaborating, and exploring new possibilities.We believe in teamwork, innovation, and thinking beyond boundaries. As a team, we are excited to learn, create, and take our first steps towards making a difference.We are ORVEXIA – Ready to explore beyond limits! 🌌
